fix_subject: Reject UTF-16 input with a trailing odd byte, and fix get_bit/set_bit bound check
pr_title: Merge #26639: Reject UTF-16 input with a trailing odd byte, and fix get_bit/set_bit bound check

labels.summary: The UTF-16 decoder read two bytes per code unit, so a trailing odd byte produced a garbage character instead of an 'not utf-16 encoded' error; the commit now raises that error, and also fixes an unsigned underflow in get_bit/set_bit's bounds check for empty bitstrings.
